items.title: A finitely locally free module trivial on every fibre comes from the base over a reduced base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a flat proper finitely presented family whose structure sheaf pushes forward to the structure sheaf of the base, stably under base change, a finite locally free module that is trivial on every fibre is pulled back from the base when the base is reduced. The proof uses the diagonal representability result to obtain a locally closed immersion parameterising the triviality locus, observes that the hypothesis makes it bijective, and then concludes it is an isomorphism because the base is reduced. Combining the locally closed immersion with bijectivity and reducedness is the content. Retained author proof at lines 9326-9331.
